summary: Verified the admin-only 'last updated' chapter badge feature end-to-end. Backend: GET /api/curriculum/units returns a parseable ISO-8601 'last_updated' on every turtle chapter; PUT /problems/{id}, PUT /problems/{id}/move, POST /curriculum/rename-lesson, and POST /curriculum/rename-chapter all stamp updated_at on affected problems (verified by reading Mongo directly after each mutation). Frontend: Admin (astapp@spanola.net) sees all 6 turtle chapter cards with a 'chapter-last-updated-<unit.id>' badge rendering '🛠 admin · updated 6 mo ago'. Non-admin teacher (test.user.1760736702@example.com) sees 0 such badges and the literal phrase 'admin · updated' is absent from the page — privacy gate confirmed.
critical_code_review_comments: Badge text uses lowercase source ('admin · updated') with CSS uppercase transform. Functional & passes the spec, but if any downstream code/test relies on textContent matching the visual uppercase, it will miss. Consider hard-coding the uppercase in JSX so DOM text matches what users see.

TurtleCurriculum is now rendering 6 chapter cards (chapter_1_0 .. chapter_6_5) rather than the 5 mentioned in the review request. Backend correctly returns 6 turtle chapters (a 6th was added since the spec was written). Not a regression — flagging only because the spec assumed 5.

/api/curriculum/units (line ~2386–2422) performs N+1 queries: a distinct() + count_documents() + aggregate() per chapter per unit. Acceptable now but will become a hotspot as the curriculum grows; consider a single aggregation pipeline per unit.
test_credentials: Admin: astapp@spanola.net / AlisaFaith$14. Non-admin teacher: test.user.1760736702@example.com / Byte-6582-Reset. Both logged in via POST /api/auth/teacher-login.
seed_data_creation: test_last_updated_badge.py inserts ONE synthetic doc into the `problems` collection under assignment_type='block' with a TEST_LAST_UPDATED_PROBE_* title/chapter/lesson, exercises PUT/move/rename-lesson/rename-chapter against it, then deletes all docs matching the TEST_LAST_UPDATED_PROBE title regex in teardown. No turtle/block seed data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent:
Iteration 18 verified the admin-only 'updated X ago' chapter badge. Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_last_updated_badge.py (5 tests, all pass). Mongo doc field is updated_at (ISO-8601 string); the curriculum endpoint exposes it as chapter.last_updated. Frontend testid pattern: chapter-last-updated- where unit.id is 'chapter__'. Badge source text is lowercase ('🛠 admin · updated ') with CSS uppercase. Privacy gate works because the JSX guard is `{user?.is_admin && unit.lastUpdated && ...}` — non-admin user simply does not render the

tag at all (verified via querySelectorAll returning 0 and full-body innerText regex /admin\s*[·•]\s*updated/i returning false).
rca of the issue:
